brief_feedback: The prescribed single whole view, one view of each supplied half, frozen unresolved list and one enhanced crop per unresolved locus were followed. All 22 crops were actually displayed once. No OCR, outside lookup, compilation, other-page image, other-reader output or subagent was used. H is descriptive only, so h is null and diff_h false throughout; its note was not made into a text witness. A full local TikZ arrangement was needed to preserve the long rules in relation to the text. Every text row/continuation and every nested deletion, raised insertion, caret, underline drawing and rule has an inventory row. The faint far-left trace has certain visible geometry but uncertain physical origin, so it is drawn without editorial interpretation. There was no mathematically substantive proof or computation to perform from this correction list; math_checks is therefore empty rather than a claim based only on transcription.
